description: Defines the QboneSessionBase class, a base class for managing QUIC sessions with QBONE protocol integration, including packet processing, stream management, and statistics tracking.

classes.name: QboneSessionBase
classes.description: A base class for QBONE-enabled QUIC sessions, managing packet processing, stream creation, and session statistics.

methods.name: QboneSessionBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with connection, owner, config, supported versions, and writer.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Overrides to ensure crypto session creation.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Overrides to handle stream frames.

methods.name: OnMessageReceived
methods.description: Overrides to handle received MESSAGE frames.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromNetwork
methods.description: Pure virtual method to process packets from network.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromPeer
methods.description: Pure virtual method to process packets from peer.

methods.name: GetNumEphemeralPackets
methods.description: Returns count of packets fitting into a single stream frame.

methods.name: GetNumStreamedPackets
methods.description: Returns count of packets requiring multiple streams.

methods.name: GetNumMessagePackets
methods.description: Returns count of packets sent via MESSAGE frames.

methods.name: GetNumFallbackToStream
methods.description: Returns count of fallback to stream attempts.

methods.name: set_writer
methods.description: Sets the packet writer.

methods.name: set_send_packets_as_messages
methods.description: Configures whether to send packets as MESSAGE frames.

methods.name: CreateCryptoStream
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create crypto stream.

methods.name: GetMutableCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns mutable crypto stream.

methods.name: GetCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns const crypto stream.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Creates incoming stream by ID.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Creates incoming stream from pending.

methods.name: ShouldKeepConnectionAlive
methods.description: Determines if connection should stay alive.

methods.name: MaybeIncreaseLargestPeerStreamId
methods.description: Overrides to possibly increase largest peer stream ID.

methods.name: CreateOutgoingStream
methods.description: Creates an outgoing stream.

methods.name: CreateDataStream
methods.description: Creates a data stream with specified ID.

methods.name: ActivateDataStream
methods.description: Activates a data stream.

methods.name: SendPacketToPeer
methods.description: Sends a packet to peer, creating ephemeral stream if needed.
